name: Icon
summary: Inline SVG sized to the text and drawn in its colour; decorative unless labelled.

guidance.useFor: Supporting a word: in buttons, alerts, list items; or standing alone with a label when the meaning is universal (close, search).
insteadUse: Meaning only an icon would carry: add the words
Decoration that adds nothing: leave it out
content: Decorative icons say nothing; a labelled icon's label says what it means ("Warning"), not what it shows ("Triangle")

rungReason: Inline <svg> takes currentColor and scales with text; aria-hidden or role="img" with a name are native attributes.

a11y.role: none when decorative (aria-hidden); img when labelled
a11y.name: aria-label when it means something on its own; otherwise the text beside it

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

props.label: makes it role=img with that name
every <svg> prop; children are the paths

rules: 1.25em square: it follows the text size
Icons are open-licensed (OFL, MIT, ISC) and self-hosted; Lue UI ships none yet
forcedColors: currentColor follows the forced text colour
